title: A customization made in a developer's Studio is lost at deploy, with no notice and no pointer in the project docs
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

From a real-user walkthrough of the development flow, filed on the maintainer's word: 「第一组：会卡住人或误导人，立卡」 (2026-11-04). Measured on `main` `987ff33b88` unless a line says otherwise. Test project scaffolded with `create-objectstack@18.3.0`.

Governing text: ADR-0146 D2: customizations live in `<base>.custom` and are "exported… committed, reviewed and deployed". This card is about telling the developer that. #30106 tracks the install half, which is broken today.

## What a customer sees

A developer runs `os dev`, tunes a view in Studio, is happy with it, then deploys with `os build` and the generated `Dockerfile`. The change is not in production, and nothing warned them.

## Measured

A view override saved and published into `com.example.asset-repair.custom` on `os dev` is served by that instance.

| Where | Contains the change? |
|:--|:--|
| `src/` | No |
| `dist/objectstack.json` after `os build` | No |
| `os package export` output | Yes |

`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/AGENTS.md` and `templates/blank/README.md` do not contain the word Studio. A search of the Studio views for an environment-scope notice or `package export` found neither. The Studio screens were not walked for a notice in this run.

## Expected

- Studio says plainly, where a customization is saved, that it lives in this environment's database and how it moves.
- The generated README and AGENTS.md name `os package export`, and when an agent should edit code rather than Studio.

The seat does not propose writing Studio changes back into `src/`.
